# RedHanded

Runs an npm package in a sandbox baited with fake credentials and a fake internet, and reports what it tried to do. Fixed rules decide the verdict. Text inside a package cannot change it.

Verdicts: CLEAN (allow), REVIEW (ask a human), HIGH and CRITICAL (block).

## MCP

POST /mcp, stateless HTTP. Tools: check_package, check_lockfile_change, get_scan_report.

## HTTP

POST /api/scan {"package": "name@version"} returns {"job": id}
POST /api/lockfile {"new_lockfile": "...", "old_lockfile": "..."} returns {"job": id}
GET /api/jobs/{id} returns state, verdict and result
GET /api/scans/{scan_id} returns the report and evidence

Limit: 12 scans an hour per address.
